card.name: Slot just before "among" a group
card.fires_on: The word right before an expected "among" or "in" plus a group of people, such as work, use, risk, or cancers. It fires on a noun or verb that is about to be followed by a population.

modes.label: Activity among a people
modes.description: A noun or verb of activity or presence followed by "among" a named population.

modes.label: Rate or risk in a group
modes.description: A health or usage term that is about to be tied to a population group.
modes.example: Cancer of the cervix (sir-vix) is one of the most common<< cancers>> in women.

card.writes: It promotes "among", "amongst" and "among" in other languages, so the next word is likely to introduce a group.
card.plain: It marks the point where the text is about to say "among" a certain group of people.
